basis: Immunodeficiency and pancytopenia 4/4; developmental/learning deficits 3/4; hemivertebrae 2/2. Eczema (2/4) omitted by cap; recurrent infections do not establish other organ damage.
Angle-closure glaucoma causes ocular damage; no other organ involvement established.
Defined by skeletal-muscle weakness and tubular aggregates; no common extra-muscular damage established.
Definition specifies POLE-associated colorectal cancer; colorectal polyposis affects the same axis.
Developmental malformation of the diaphragm, a skeletal muscle; associated lung damage is not established across this umbrella.
Paralysis of all four limbs is a neurologic functional deficit; it does not itself establish primary muscle damage.
Renal cysts 16/17 and renal insufficiency 10/19. Hypertension (9/18) is a separately diagnosed secondary condition.
Neonatal atrial arrhythmia with frequent ventricular dysfunction; tachypnea does not establish pulmonary damage.
Developmental/seizure syndrome with skeletal deformities and cardiac defects; hearing loss 30-79%. Reflux (100%) and laryngomalacia (30-79%) omitted by cap.
Familial visceral neuropathy affects enteric nerves and causes intestinal dysmotility/pseudo-obstruction; other organ damage is not established across subtypes.
Carcinoma originates in renal tubular epithelium; metastatic organ damage is not established in at least 30% across all patients.
Localized cutaneous mucin deposition with papules and variable fibrosis; definition explicitly excludes thyroid disease.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; hepatic steatosis, ventricular hypertrophy/heart failure and brain atrophy each reported in 1/1 phenotyped patients; evidence is sparse.
Vestibulocerebellar dysfunction causes ataxia, vertigo and abnormal eye movements; these do not establish intrinsic eye or inner-ear damage.
Inflammation of the exocrine pancreas; endocrine failure and autoimmune mechanisms do not apply to most patients across this umbrella.
Definition specifies a midline lower-lip cleft. Mandibular bone involvement is not established as a necessary or common feature by the supplied definition.
Periapical dental inflammation usually results from infected necrotic pulp; sterile traumatic or chemical causes also occur.
Immunodeficiency with EDS-like connective-tissue disease and chronic cutaneous candidiasis; oral candidiasis is a characteristic defining mucosal manifestation.
Tumor arises from extrahepatic bile ducts, which belong to the hepatic axis.
Autoinflammatory interferonopathy; AGS-like encephalopathy and neurodevelopmental damage predominate (>30%). Connective-tissue ancestry alone does not establish skeletal damage.
Immune-mediated peripheral nerve demyelination; weakness reflects neuropathy. Respiratory abnormalities are very rare (1-4%).
Constitutional cancer syndrome defined by hematologic, brain and intestinal neoplasia; labels describe defining tumor sites, without assuming concurrent damage.
Site-unspecified mature teratoma is predominantly gonadal/reproductive; CNS, pericardial and gastric variants do not establish a common covered organ across the umbrella.
Ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor involving hormone-producing Sertoli-Leydig tissue, commonly with androgen excess; gonadal endocrine tissue belongs to this axis.
Defined by skin inflammation; the umbrella includes diverse causes and does not establish a uniform infectious or immune-mediated mechanism.
